# Google sign-in button provenance

Retrieved November 8, 2026 from Google's preapproved branding bundle linked by
https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines

Bundle: https://developers.google.com/static/identity/images/signin-assets.zip

Archive entry: `Android + Web/PNG @2x/Light/Theme=Light, Show text=Yes, Shape=Square, Platform=Android+Web@2x.png`

Local asset: `google-signin-light.png`. Original 360 × 80 PNG bytes are unchanged.
SHA-256: `fdd355abc194d6acc0837c9b5e8a3170d6ae07dfeb85a63d3eb4b7fbfc2bb63f`.
The HTML button scales the whole image proportionally to 180 × 40 CSS pixels;
it provides its own accessible name, keyboard focus and disabled state. No
remote font, Google SDK, custom logo or network request is needed to display it.
Use is subject to Google's sign-in branding guidelines; this provenance note
does not imply Google has verified or endorsed AssayNova.
